build_nt351_1_7: 1.7-nt351 (2026-10-29): shutdown log in disk sector 4 of the USOS NT 3.x disk (stage letters R/P/S/F/Z, src/platform/bios/nt3/nt3_e820_mbr.S rotates it per boot), and on restart/reboot (also after a bugcheck) NVMe CC.SHN + CC.EN=0, xHCI R/S=0 + HCRST, Bus Master off on NVMe/xHCI/NIC, then CF9h 0Ah/0Eh full reset before the old order. NT 3.51 build only; the other binaries are unchanged (USOSRST_SHUTLOG code).
build_nt351_1_8: 1.8-nt351 (2026-10-29): RAM marker page at physical 50000000h (above /MAXMEM=1024, prepared by the pre-boot logger tools/nt_bootlog, written only when its USOSPRE1 header is valid, mapped non-cached): stage letters L/R/P/S/F/digit/Z/Q/C/K at any IRQL, bugcheck count and the five KiBugCheckData words (address from the five absolute stores at the start of KeBugCheckEx; found at 80147540h in the X470 install's 3.51 kernel). Load line m-/m+/mk. NT 3.51 build only (USOSRST_RAMLOG); the other binaries are unchanged.
build_nt4n: build-nt4n.cmd (same source, -DUSOSRST_NT4 -DUSOSRST_NT4N, PE version 4.00) -> bin/nt4n/i386/usosrst.sys, version string usosrst 1.8-nt4n: native NT 4.0 only (staged as USOSRSTN.SYS), the NT 3.51 1.7/1.8 shutdown log, NVMe/xHCI/NIC quiesce, CF9h full reset and RAM marker page; bin/nt4 (VM path, 1.5-nt4) unchanged
build_nt4n_1_9: 1.9-nt4n (2026-10-29): power-off. The kernel HalReturnToFirmware(HalPowerDownRoutine) call (NtShutdownSystem(ShutdownPowerOff), Winlogon PowerdownAfterShutdown=1) goes to ACPI S5: SLP_TYPa/b from the DSDT _S5 package, WAK_STS cleared, SLP_TYP+SLP_EN in PM1a/PM1b_CNT after the shutdown log and the device quiesce; the HAL routine only if the machine still runs. Load line s5o/s5x/s5-, also stored as the Parameters value LoadLine (REG_BINARY ASCII) for offline readback. USOSRST_POWEROFF, NT4N build only; the other binaries are unchanged.
build_nt4n_1_10: 1.10-nt4n (2026-10-29 round 2): the kernel import slot is written through MmGetPhysicalAddress + MmMapIoSpace (NT 4.0 maps the kernel with large pages; the MDL path of 1.9 failed: LoadLine handler=off, restarts by triple fault, power-off came back on). Before S5: GPE0/GPE1 enables 0 and status cleared, PM1_EN = PWRBTN_EN only, PM1_STS W1C 0xC731, RTC alarm interrupt off, PCI PME_En off + PME_Status cleared on the quiesced NVMe/xHCI/NIC. LoadLine adds typ=, pm1=, gpe= (160-byte line). NT4N only.
build_nt4n_1_11: 1.11-nt4n (2026-10-29 round 3): LoadLine was handler=off with 1.10 too, so when the kernel import slot cannot be redirected a 5-byte jmp at the start of the HAL HalReturnToFirmware (written byte by byte through physical addresses) takes every routine: restart/reboot full reset, power-down ACPI S5, halt stops the CPU (handler=inl). Load line k+/k- and the slot result (n/0/x). NT4N only.
imports_nt4n: 61: ntoskrnl, hal; all resolve on the NT 4.0 RTM (1381.1) ntoskrnl/ntkrnlmp and hal/halmps/halapic (tools/tests/data/nt4rtm_exports.txt)
build_nt35_1_7: 1.7-nt35 (2026-10-30, native NT 3.5): the NT 3.51 1.7/1.8 shutdown log, NVMe/xHCI/NIC quiesce, CF9h full reset and RAM marker page, plus the 1.9-1.11 ACPI S5 power-off for HalPowerDownRoutine (kernel import slot via MDL, HAL inline jmp as fallback, handler=on/inl). Imports resolve on the NT 3.5 (807) ntoskrnl/hal.
boot_screen_2026_10_30: Every NT 4.0 / 3.x build (USOSRST_NT4): the white boot-screen rows (load line, heartbeat, clock, restart note) only when SystemStartOptions has SOS (BOOT.INI [USOS /SOS]); red rows (STOP, stall) always. Load line token osd+/osd-. Version strings of nt4/nt4n/nt351/nt31 unchanged.
